opportunities.title: Serve images in next-gen formats
opportunities.description: Image formats like WebP and AVIF often provide better compression than PNG or JPEG, which means faster downloads and less data consumption.

opportunities.title: Reduce unused JavaScript
opportunities.description: Reduce unused JavaScript and defer loading scripts until they are required to decrease bytes consumed by network activity.

opportunities.title: Eliminate render-blocking resources
opportunities.description: Resources are blocking the first paint of your page. Consider delivering critical JS/CSS inline and deferring all non-critical JS/styles.

opportunities.title: Reduce unused CSS
opportunities.description: Reduce unused rules from stylesheets and defer CSS not used for above-the-fold content to decrease bytes consumed by network activity.

diagnostics.title: Avoid an excessive DOM size
diagnostics.description: A large DOM will increase memory usage, cause longer style calculations, and produce costly layout reflows.

diagnostics.title: Minimize main-thread work
diagnostics.description: Consider reducing the time spent parsing, compiling and executing JS. You may find rendering and layout optimization help.

diagnostics.title: JavaScript execution time
diagnostics.description: Consider reducing the time spent parsing, compiling, and executing JS. You may find delivery optimization helpful.

diagnostics.title: Ensure text remains visible during webfont load
diagnostics.description: Use the css font-display property to ensure text is user-visible while the webfont is loading.

passed.title: Document has a `<title>` element
passed.description: The title element gives screen reader users and search engine crawlers an overview of the page context.

passed.title: Has a `<meta name="viewport">` tag with `width` or `initial-scale`
passed.description: Optimizes mobile layout and text sizing.

passed.title: Page has successful HTTP status code
passed.description: Returns a valid status code so crawlers can index it.

passed.title: Content is sized correctly for the viewport
passed.description: Ensures users don't need to scroll horizontally.

passed.title: robots.txt is valid
passed.description: Crawilers read this file to understand indexing rules.

passed.title: Image elements have [alt] attributes
passed.description: Images are annotated properly for accessibility and engines.

failed.title: Document does not have a meta description
failed.description: Meta descriptions may be included in search results to concisely summarize page content.

passed.title: `[aria-hidden="true"]` is not present on the document `<body>`
passed.description: Assistive technologies are not blocked from reading components.

passed.title: `<html>` element has a `[lang]` attribute
passed.description: Allows screen readers to pronounce words correctly.

passed.title: Page contains a heading, skip link, or landmark region

failed.title: Background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio.
failed.description: Low-contrast text is difficult or impossible for many users to read.

failed.title: ARIA attributes are not valid or misspelled
failed.description: Ensures assistive technologies can read widgets correctly.

passed.title: Avoids submitting production maps
passed.description: Prevents exposing internal application code structures directly.

passed.title: Page has the HTML doctype
passed.description: Prevents browser rendering in Quirks Mode.

passed.title: Legible font sizes are maintained
passed.description: Font sizes are large enough to be legible on mobile displays.

passed.title: No browser errors logged to the console
passed.description: Page executed clean of console errors.
